final.name: Narrative Escalation
final.audit_justification: This scores the comic structure of a premise escalating to a disproportionate endpoint, a genuine craft property of the joke.

final.name: Joke mechanism matches the hashtag's named genre
final.audit_justification: This scores whether the comedic technique used is exactly what the contest's named theme calls for, a genuine fit-to-prompt craft judgment.

final.name: Pun stacks two or more meanings at once
final.audit_justification: This scores the wordplay technique of stacking two meanings at once in a pun, a craft property of the joke's construction.

final.name: Transgressive Integration
final.audit_justification: This scores whether taboo material is integrated into a specific comic mechanism versus used as raw shock value, a craft judgment.

final.name: Obvious-first-take fingerprint
final.audit_justification: This explicitly scores only how conventional/first-association the premise is and disclaims judging originality or quality, making it a topic-obviousness fingerprint.
final.upstream_parent: position in the entry stream or submission timing

final.name: Reliance on franchise scaffolding: sequel numbers, colons, subtitles
final.audit_justification: Although it cites punctuation cues (colons, numerals) as evidence, the score is really whether the entrant contributed genuine new material versus a grafted word onto borrowed title structure, a craft/originality judgment.

final.name: Contest boilerplate load
final.audit_justification: This scores the amount of visible platform/contest boilerplate text and explicitly disclaims judging whether the entry is good.
final.upstream_parent: author's familiarity with contest submission conventions

final.name: Title Reengineering Depth
final.audit_justification: This scores how substantively a recognizable title was reworked into a coherent new premise, a genuine craft judgment.

final.name: Alliteration, rhyme, or rhythmic sound-play
final.audit_justification: This scores use of alliteration, rhyme, or rhythmic patterning in the wording, a craft/wording-choice property.

final.name: Concrete Cultural Texture
final.audit_justification: This scores whether specific, culturally grounded objects and practices build a vivid world versus vague labels, a content/craft property.

final.name: Temporal anchoring
final.audit_justification: This scores only the amount of explicit temporal/date specificity present and disclaims judging timeliness or goodness, though the same underlying preference for concrete specificity could also drive genuinely sharper jokes.
final.upstream_parent: submission timing and topical news cycle

final.name: Stereotype Avoidance
final.audit_justification: This scores whether the entry uses an unusual, non-interchangeable detail versus an expected stereotype bundle, a craft/originality judgment.

final.name: Morphological Wordplay
final.audit_justification: This scores whether a coined or blended word creates a layered joke, a wordplay craft property.

final.name: Spoken in character versus described from outside
final.audit_justification: This scores whether the line reads as a genuine in-character utterance rather than an outside description, a craft judgment about voice construction.

final.name: Presence of an attached URL or media pointer
final.audit_justification: This scores only the presence/prominence of an attached URL or media pointer and explicitly disclaims judging whether the link helps, making it a formatting marker.
final.upstream_parent: composition mode: the entry was authored as a photo or link tweet from a client that appends a URL

final.name: Proper-noun reference density
final.audit_justification: This scores the density of named entities used and explicitly disclaims judging whether the references are effective, though the same preference for concrete named things over generic ones could also drive genuinely better jokes.
final.upstream_parent: author's media repertoire and audience familiarity

final.name: Taboo-trigger density
final.audit_justification: This scores the density of taboo material present and explicitly disclaims judging whether the entry is good, making it a topic-density marker distinct from whether the material is put to skillful use.
final.upstream_parent: audience norm sensitivity and platform-moderation climate

final.name: Partisan-trigger density
final.audit_justification: This scores the density of partisan/ideological cues present and explicitly disclaims judging whether the entry is good, making it a topic marker.

final.name: Reference predictability / top-of-mind obviousness within its category
final.audit_justification: This scores how predictable/canonical the referenced item is and explicitly disclaims ever judging whether the joke built on it is good.
final.upstream_parent: position in the entry stream / idea-crowding (obvious ideas get submitted first and are independently duplicated by many entrants, which can affect how fresh or stale a reader/judge perceives an entry as)

final.name: Consistent in-character dialect/persona voice
final.audit_justification: This scores whether a sustained, distinct persona voice is maintained throughout the entry, a craft judgment about character construction.

final.name: Stock phrase reuse
final.audit_justification: This scores how much the wording resembles a reused slogan or template and explicitly disclaims judging whether the phrase is effective.

final.name: Self-contained text; no link dependency or off-topic tags
final.audit_justification: This scores whether the entry depends on an external link/image or extra tag clutter versus standing alone in the visible words, a formatting/dependency property, though the underlying skill of making a joke work in text alone could also mark genuinely better writing.
final.arbiter_reason: The instruction tells the judge to score a structural dependency property (presence of a URL or image payload, count of stray hashtags, tag clutter) rather than the wit itself, and it explicitly says to score the dependency and not the topic, so a completely unfunny but self-contained single-tag line earns a 10 and a high score carries no evidence about how good the entry is. Its signal runs only in the low direction as a surface format fingerprint of how the item was posted, which is exactly a Track-B nuisance, though it is mixed because the discipline of landing a joke in visible words alone plausibly co-produces genuine craft.

final.name: List whose final item swerves against the earlier ones
final.audit_justification: This scores whether a list's final item structurally swerves against and reframes the earlier items, a genuine comic-structure craft judgment.

final.name: Extra hashtags beyond the contest tag
final.audit_justification: This scores the count of hashtags beyond the contest tag and explicitly disclaims assessing whether they are relevant or witty.
final.upstream_parent: audience and following effects: the author is recruiting attention or addressing a subgroup outside the contest

final.name: Surface-Meaning Irony
final.audit_justification: This scores whether the literal wording clearly conflicts with an implied comic meaning, a classic ironic craft device.
